description:
The process starts with identifying an idea for a new product or improvement to an existing one.
The R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies, followed by drafting design concepts.
After selecting a promising design, a prototype is built using available materials and resources.
The prototype undergoes various tests to assess its functionality, safety, and market potential.
Feedback from the testing phase is collected, and the prototype may be refined accordingly.
If a refinement is needed, then the testing phase is reinitiated.
The process ends when the prototype is either approved for further development or discarded.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ProductPrototype"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-prototype">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductPrototype" name="Product Prototype Development" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify an idea for a new product or improvement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResearchFeasibility" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility studies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select a promising design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety, and market potential"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Is refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" name="Approve for further development?" default="Flow_Discarded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved for further development"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Discarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Research" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Research_Draft" sourceRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_Select" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Build" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refinementNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Retest" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approvedForFurtherDevelopment</bpmn:conditionExpression>

  </bpmn:process>
